questions.question: Grouping of any thing into convenient categories based on some easily observable characters are called :-
Which of the following characters indicate similarity between fungi and animals :-
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 4) All the above.
Explanation: Fungi and animals share several characteristics:


\tHeterotrophic nutrition: Both fungi and animals are heterotrophic, meaning they depend on other organisms for food (fungi through absorption, animals through ingestion).
\tType of stored food: Both store food in the form of glycogen, which is similar to animals.
\tPresence of chitin: Fungi have chitin in their cell walls, a characteristic also found in the exoskeletons of arthropods (animals like insects and crustaceans).
